collection.title: SEAT Altea MPV 2004 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the SEAT Altea MPV 2004 to 2008 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Claw wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Altea which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
